description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? 

 Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

 Build the Cloud Foundation Behind Sony Interactive Entertainment

 Every day, engineering teams across Sony Interactive Entertainment rely on the platforms we build to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable services. IT Cloud Foundations engineers the cloud capabilities that power enterprise business systems, developer platforms, and data services across the company.

 Our customers are both engineers and the businesses they support. Every improvement we make to automation, reliability, security, and cloud infrastructure directly accelerates engineering teams while improving the reliability of critical business services.

 The solutions we build become reusable capabilities that scale across the enterprise—not just for a single application or project.

 Our mission isn't simply to manage cloud infrastructure—it's to engineer the secure, scalable cloud platform that enables Sony Interactive Entertainment to operate, innovate, and grow.

 More Than Infrastructure

 Some days you'll provision new AWS infrastructure, expand cloud networking, or enable new application environments. Other days you'll automate repetitive work, improve observability, or build reusable cloud capabilities. We believe every infrastructure request is an opportunity to improve the platform through automation, reusable engineering patterns, and thoughtful design.

 The Challenges You'll Help Us Solve

 
 Reduce manual operational work through automation.

 Improve cloud governance without slowing engineering teams down.

 Deliver secure, resilient AWS infrastructure for business-critical services.

 Evolve Kubernetes, observability, and engineering platforms.

 
 What You'll Work On

 
 AWS infrastructure, networking, IAM, compute, storage, and shared cloud services.

 Terraform, Python, Infrastructure as Code, and automation.

 Partnering with Networking, Security, Identity, Database, Platform, Data, and Application Engineering.

 Kubernetes (EKS), CI/CD, observability, governance, and operational excellence.

 
 Technology You'll Work With

 AWS • Terraform • Kubernetes/EKS • Helm • Python • GitHub Actions • GitOps • Lambda • IAM • Route 53 • Transit Gateway • CloudWatch • Datadog • Prometheus • Grafana • Cloud Custodian

  

 How We Engineer

 
 Build cloud infrastructure that is secure, resilient, automated, and designed to evolve with the business.

 Automate first whenever a pattern is repeatable.

 Build security and governance into every solution.

 Partner across engineering organizations to deliver better outcomes.

 Continuously improve the platform through practical, measurable engineering.

 Use AI where it meaningfully improves engineering outcomes.

 
 What We're Looking For

 We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving problems, are curious about how things work, and continually look for better ways to deliver secure, reliable cloud infrastructure. If you see automation opportunities where others see repetitive work and enjoy partnering across engineering teams, you'll fit right in.

  

 Qualifications

 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.

 Hands-on experience building and operating AWS infrastructure using IaC.

 Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, Python, CI/CD, and cloud networking.

 Strong troubleshooting and automation skills.

 AWS certification is a plus.

 3+ years of relevant experience.

 
  

 Required Experience

 
 Experience building, deploying, and supporting AWS cloud infrastructure.

 Hands-on IaC experience and Terraform.

 Experience with Kubernetes administration and containerized applications.

 Experience developing automation using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.

 Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines.

 Understanding of AWS networking concepts including VPCs, routing, VPNs, security groups, and load balancing.

 Experience administering Linux systems.

 Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, networking, compute, and storage.

 Experience using monitoring and logging tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, or Splunk.

 Experience using Git source control.

 Understanding of cloud security best practices.

 Ability to work collaboratively within Agile teams.

 
  

 Technology Evolves. So Do We.

 We value curiosity, ownership, continuous learning, and engineers who continually challenge themselves—and us—to build better platforms, automate intelligently, and raise the standard for cloud engineering.

 Join us in building the cloud foundation that enables Sony Interactive Entertainment to operate, innovate, and scale securely.

  
 At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.
 
Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. 
 
In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click  here to learn more. 

  

 The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.
 $136,400 — $204,600 USD 


 Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

 Please refer to our  Candidate Privacy Notice  for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

 Equal Opportunity Statement: 

 Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category. 

 We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.  

 Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.
